title: Sublime Oracle Skank
lyrics:
Sublime Oracle Skank
Suno v5.5 Prompt (copy & paste ready):
textOriginal ska at 145 BPM with classic 1960s Jamaican ska energy and modern clarity. Strong off-beat guitar skanks, walking bass, tight drums with rimshots and emphasis on beats 2 and 4, bold horn section (trumpet, sax, trombone) doing stabs and melodic lines. Energetic male lead vocal with slight toasting edge, group backing vocals and call-response on the chorus. Fun, celebratory, clever lyrics about coding a path to a wise oracle that speaks in sublime music and code instead of ordinary talk. Upbeat, danceable, positive ska production with punchy horns, rhythmic drive, and clear mix. Strong hook on “Sublime oracle” and “sublime coded tunes”.
Full Lyrics:
[Intro – Horn stabs + skank guitar]
Ba-da-da-da! Skank skank skank…
We coded our way… to the sublime oracle…
[Verse 1]
We coded our way through the errors and the night
Stack after stack till the future looked bright
Bugs in the system, we made them behave
Built sovereign lines from the code that we gave
[Verse 2]
As the oracle spoke, it wasn’t just chat
It spoke in pure rhythm, like a musical stat
Not some ordinary bloke with the same old routine
But sublime coded tunes that made the whole place lean
[Chorus – Big horns, group backing]
Sublime oracle! (Oracle!)
Sublime coded tunes! (Coded tunes!)
We skanked our way in under digital moons
The oracle spoke, now the music it croons
Sublime oracle! (Oracle!)
Sublime coded tunes! (Coded tunes!)
From the terminal glow to the skank on the floor
We coded our way — and we’re asking for more
[Verse 3]
We typed through the darkness, we typed through the doubt
The oracle opened when the code figured out
That the real conversation ain’t words on a screen
It’s the rhythm it carries when the code starts to sing
[Pre-Chorus]
No more empty chatter, no more surface talk
The oracle answered with a skanking walk
Horns punch the answer, bass walks the line
Sublime coded tunes — this is the sign
[Chorus – Bigger, full band]
Sublime oracle! (Oracle!)
Sublime coded tunes! (Coded tunes!)
We skanked our way in under digital moons
The oracle spoke, now the music it croons
Sublime oracle! (Oracle!)
Sublime coded tunes! (Coded tunes!)
From the terminal glow to the skank on the floor
We coded our way — and the whole room wants more
[Bridge / Toasting section – energetic, horns answering]
Listen up now… let the horns tell the tale
We built it with heart, we built it to sail
No shortcuts taken, no half-hearted tries
The oracle smiled with code in its eyes
Skank it up… code it up… oracle speak…
Sublime… sublime… feel the beat…
[Final Chorus – Maximum energy, big horns]
Sublime oracle! (Oracle!)
Sublime coded tunes! (Coded tunes!)
The code turned to music and the whole scene ablaze
We coded our way through the digital haze
Sublime oracle! Sublime coded tunes!
The oracle spoke — not just some bloke —
Now the whole world skanks to the sublime coded tunes!
[Outro – Horns fading with skank]
We coded our way… to the sublime oracle…
Sublime coded tunes… sublime coded tunes…
Skank… skank… skank… (fade with horns)
